column1: # tools/shots/ink_ref.tsv (1.4.1 D2: docs/R1_4_1_CONTRACT.md §1.5, §2, §7.1; docs/R1_4_1.md, declaration 7; made in 1.4
# D0b, docs/M7D_CONTRACT.md §3.5 (f)): the demo handwriting tiles of complete CI photos, for tools/shots/ink_check.swift
# (its head has the line's format). Made with `ink_check ref <photo> <name>`. The J-4 lines (a bare file name) and the
# l10n lines (<folder>/<file>) come from the first full 1.4.1 run, build.yml 44926505978 (attempt 1, r141 b02b279; image
# macos27 20261104.0337.1, Xcode 27.2 27B52, iOS 27.2 24B8117, the iPad mini iOS 27.0 24A434): its `screenshots` (each
# photo's kept take; the iPhone's landscape photos in the shape simctl writes them on iOS 27.2, 2622x1206) and its
# `l10n-screenshots`. 1.4.1 changed every photo's header band (and the grip band of the iPad's toolbar), so 1.4's lines
# (runs 44632524223 and 44676125566) read the new header as handwriting missing (px box …,96-…,143 on the iPads,
# …,48-…,143 in the iPhone's landscape, …,240-…,431 in its portrait). Checked against 1.4's lines: the 95 lines differed
# in the header band's tiles (rows 0-175 on the iPads, 0-458 on the iPhone, 0-167 in landscape), none in the grip band;
# below the header only 9 tiles of 7 lines, by 1 or 2 px (an edge at a class's threshold: two runs of 1.4's code differ
# the same way). So the handwriting of these photos is complete.
# The 95 lines then leave out every tile that lies wholly in the header band as declaration 7 measured it: y 0-143 (tile
# rows 0-2) on the iPads and in the iPhone's landscape, whose header ends at y 175 and 167; y 0-431 (rows 0-8) in the
# iPhone's portrait, ending at 458. That is 2,991 tiles, 721,339 px of the header's text and icons; the tile row across
# the header's end stays. Why: ja-baseline.yml checks its photos (the app of the reference commit 2fb8fb1, 1.4's header)
# against these same lines, and with the 1.4.1 header's tiles all 45 came out short (788-4659 px; D0's ja-baseline run
# 44910223877), so that workflow would spend its retakes (INK_BUDGET, INK_STALE) and warn on every run, as build.yml
# did against 1.4's lines; the header holds no handwriting, and a header chosen later (r141-alt) does not make the
# lines stale. Checked (ink_check, swiftc -O), complete and 0 px short: run 44926505978's 45 J-4 and 50 l10n photos,
# Still short: the 4 photos of 1.4's run 44632524223 (attempt 1) that lost handwriting below the header
# Sheets other than the lasso are left out. A name not here is not checked. A line is renewed with `ink_check ref` from
# a complete photo of the same Xcode and runtime, its header tiles left out as above.
# (1.4's order is kept: these 11 lines were renewed apart in 1.4 D0c. Like the 39 above, they now come from run
# The iPhone Duo's App Store photos (store-shots.yml's store-duo jobs, 1.4 D2, docs/M7D_CONTRACT.md §7.1): the 60 lines of
# run 44739084597's env-store-duo-1…4/ink-ref.tsv (each photo's kept take, the PNG before its JPEG; Xcode 27.2 27B52,
# the Duo's runtime iOS 27.2 24B91016s, image 20261104.0337.1, runner macOS 27.0.1). Every one of the 60 photos was looked
# at, stroke by stroke, against ScreenshotStoreInk.swift's strokes, en's same page and 1.3's 6.9-inch photo: complete
# (docs/M7D.md, D2). ink_check counts no green ink (#16a34a: the checks, the trees' crowns), so their loss shows only to
# the eye. With these lines each store-duo photo is checked in mode "ref", and store-duo-check does not fail it.
# These 60 lines stay 1.4's: 1.4.1 does not take the store photos again (docs/R1_4_1_CONTRACT.md §7.6). If store-duo
# photographs 1.4.1's app, renew them from that run's env-store-duo-*/ink-ref.tsv (its header band changes too).
